hooks.command: python3 -c "import importlib.util,io,json,os,runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; raw=sys.stdin.read(); sys.stdin=io.StringIO(raw); d=json.loads(raw or '{}'); args=(d.get('toolCall') or {}).get('args') or {}; cands=[Path.cwd(), *[Path(str(args.get(k))) for k in ('Cwd','AbsolutePath','TargetFile','SearchPath','DirectoryPath','file_path','path') if args.get(k)]]; roots=[p if p.is_dir() else p.parent for c in cands for p in [c,*c.parents]]; [sys.path.insert(0,str(r)) for r in roots if (r/'localsec'/'__init__.py').is_file() or (r/'localsec'/'claude_subagent_guard.py').is_file()]; sys.argv=['claude_subagent_guard','--platform','antigravity']; tp=str(d.get('transcriptPath') or ''); head=(Path(tp).expanduser().read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines()[:6] if tp and Path(tp).expanduser().is_file() else []); blk=any('LOCALSEC_BLINDED_CHALLENGER_CONTEXT' in l or '/phase-2-blinded-counterevidence-challenger' in l for l in head); runpy.run_module('localsec.claude_subagent_guard',run_name='__main__') if importlib.util.find_spec('localsec.claude_subagent_guard') else print(json.dumps({'decision':'deny','reason':'[LocalSec Blinded Guard] Blocked in blinded challenger context.'} if blk else {'decision':'allow'}))"
